description: Shared Renovate preset for Pascal-Organisation. Use in a repo's renovate.json: { "extends": ["local>Pascal-Organisation/security-pipeline//renovate/default"] }

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the release-age wait (the 7-day default is for ordinary updates only) and are labelled so they stand out.

packageRules.description: Small, aged updates merge themselves once every required check is green. Renovate merges the PR itself (platformAutomerge off: GitHub's auto-merge needs a paid plan for private repos), so every update lands as a merged PR — which release gates such as bahnbot's policy job require.
Majors always get a human look.
Our own reusable workflows, rollout ring 'stable': all pins move together, 3 days after a non-breaking release, once the gate is green.
Our own reusable workflows, rollout ring 'canary' (keep in sync with fleet/repos.json): one private and one public repo take a release at once and surface problems first.
A major release of our own workflows changes the caller contract: always by hand.

Language runtime base images (python, php, node, ...): moving the minor/major version changes the runtime, so it comes as a PR for review, never automerged. Digest refreshes of the same tag still automerge.

Registries that publish no release timestamp (Docker Hub for many images, some mirrors): without this, minimumReleaseAge would block those updates forever. Timestamped releases still wait the full age.
Own images (ghcr.io/pascal-organisation/*) are rolled out by the in-cluster updater CronJobs after the pipeline signed them: Renovate must not touch them, or the two would fight.

k3s manifests pin images by digest only, with the version in a comment: the kubernetes manager reads those as 'latest' and would move them to the newest digest of :latest. The regex manager below tracks the commented version instead, so the kubernetes manager's own digest updates are off (it still proposes tag updates for tag-pinned images).
GitHub-hosted runner image majors (e.g. ubuntu-24.04 → ubuntu-26.04) are deliberate, tested changes: the public build path depends on runner specifics.

customManagers.description: image:tag@sha256 pins inside workflow env/run lines and shell scripts (Dependabot cannot see these).
nuclei-templates release pinned in dast.yml (tag + commit).
